KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

3. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. fupi
   C. zito
   D. pana

4. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.

6. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

7. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

8. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. mato
   D. watoto

9. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

10. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain -ake na -ao) and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain miezi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
